text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water, and avoid too much sugar. Second, try to exercise regularly—even a short walk every day helps. Sleep is also important, so aim for seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by making time for hobbies and rest. Small daily habits like these can make a big difference, and you will feel happier and more energetic.
